transaction: BEGIN IMMEDIATE ... COMMIT using the existing Store atomic stage pattern
preparation: clone SelfModel from serialized current state
apply existing replace_body semantics only to the clone
construct a full prospective Organism authoritative snapshot
durable_stages: save the complete prospective snapshot at the resulting event sequence
commit_rule: Both stages commit together or both roll back.
live_apply: Only after COMMIT, replace live SelfModel and adapter state and bind Embodiment occupancy from the prepared values.
commit_before_live_apply_failure: If post-commit live apply fails, durable event plus snapshot remain coherent and restart restores the replacement exactly once.
rollback_rule: Pre-commit failure leaves ledger, snapshots, adapter, Embodiment, SelfModel, Habitat, and constitutional identity unchanged.
replay_claim: Ledger replays attachment identity; full cross-owner reconstruction uses the committed prospective snapshot plus ledger reconciliation. No event-only SelfModel reconstruction is claimed.
idempotency: A successful call is one transaction. A repeated explicit replacement is a new body transition, not an automatic retry; no internal retry exists.
